access.connectionInterrupted: The server is temporarily unavailable, for example during a restart or update. This page retries automatically and will resume once the server is available and your identity has been verified. You can stay on this window.
access.proxySessionExpired: Your sign-in session needs to be renewed. Restore connection opens a separate sign-in window without reloading this page.
access.retained: Your work remains in memory in this tab. Actions are paused until your identity is verified; no submission or change is replayed automatically.
access.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow popups for this site, then click Restore connection again.
access.renewed: Connection restored. You can close this window and return to your work in the original tab.
access.identityChangedHelp: This tab stays locked to avoid mixing data from different identities or permission levels. Sign in with the original account and permissions to resume it, or open Mergeron in a new tab to work with the new permissions.
access.inactivePerson: Your login is not linked to an active person. Contact an administrator.
